consequence: NO_BASE_UI_EQUIVALENT. Nothing in the repo currently uses a RAC Tree, so this verdict is forward-looking: nested navigation in this design system is built from Collapsible/Accordion-style primitives (Base UI Accordion/Collapsible already cover the disclosure part), but a true tree widget (roving focus across nested levels, aria-treeitem, expand/collapse keyboard model) has no Base UI equivalent.
notableDifferences: Base UI does offer the composition pieces of a tree (Collapsible for disclosure, internals/composite for flat roving focus) but no nested-level navigation model, no aria-treeitem/aria-expanded wiring, and no typeahead.
React Aria's tree (TreeItem/useTreeState) covers multi-level focus and selection semantics that would have to be hand-built on Base UI internals, which are not public API.
